description:
The food.gdt dataset is open in Gretl, containing 'food_exp' (weekly food expenditure) and 'income' for 40 households.

Your goal is to compare food expenditure between high-income and low-income households.

1. Create a new dummy variable named 'high_income' which takes the value 1 if 'income' is strictly greater than the median income, and 0 otherwise. (Hint: Use Add > Define new variable, or the console).
2. Perform a two-sample t-test (Difference of Means) to compare 'food_exp' between the two groups defined by 'high_income'. (Hint: View > Difference of means).
3. Save the full text output of the t-test to '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/ttest_results.txt'.
4. Generate a boxplot comparing the two groups and save it as an image to '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/food_boxplot.png'.

metadata.ground_truth_script:
open food.gdt
series high_income = income > median(income)
diff food_exp high_income
